rv.q: Photo by Victoria Wai Unfortunately what was originally a striking twelve minute monologue delivered direct to camera, assumes an altogether more stodgy consistency as a clunkily overwritten play of two meandering hours which at its worst moments, emulate Donald-Trump-at-a-lectern-deviating-from-the-autocue.
It's a word I hate to use in any review, but I was extremely bored throughout.
